content.text: {"id": "mm6436a1", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Overall, 77.3% of HCP survey participants reported receiving an influenza vaccination during the 2014–15 season"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Overall, 77.3% of HCP survey participants reported receiving an influenza vaccination during the 2014–15 season"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Overall, 77.3% of HCP survey participants reported receiving an influenza vaccination during the 2014–15 season"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "coverage was higher in 2014–15 among pharmacists (95.3% versus 85.7%)"}]}, {"v": "stratified/adjusted", "ev": [{"loc": "note", "q": "Restricted to respondents without an employer requirement for vaccination."}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "cross-sectional", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "CDC conducted an opt-in Internet panel survey of 1,914 HCP"}]}, {"v": "before/after or trend", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Vaccination coverage estimates from opt-in Internet panel surveys conducted during the 2010–11 through 2014–15 influenza seasons"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Responses were weighted to the distribution of the U.S. population of HCP by occupation, age, sex, race/ethnicity, work setting, and census region."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Because the study sample was based on HCP from opt-in Internet panels rather than probability samples, no statistical tests were performed."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "A change was noted as an increase or decrease when there was at least a 5 percentage point difference between estimates"}, {"loc": "note", "q": "Weights were calculated based on each occupation type, by age, sex, race/ethnicity, work setting, and U.S. Census region"}, {"loc": "table 1", "q": "Vaccination coverage estimate not reliable because the sample size was <30."}], "confidence": "medium", "uncertain_fields": ["analytic_depth"]}
